pictures.name: KDF1-Naming-Day
pictures.prompt: A grand palace hall in ancient India, garlands of flowers and oil lamps everywhere. King Suddhodana (a dignified king with a trimmed black beard and gold crown) holds the baby prince (a healthy, wide-eyed baby a few days old, wrapped in white and gold cloth), while eight brahmins in white with sacred threads sit in a row before him, studying the child. Warm gold lamplight, deep blue shadows. Contemplative sacred oil painting, one tall 9:16 picture, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow quiet mood, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.
